Separation is but the prelude to possibility.''|Schwarzloch, [[Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides]]}} '''Schwarzloch''' {{Lang|zh=斯瓦茨洛}}, also known as the '''Grand Architect''' {{Lang|zh=残星会会长}}, is a quest-exclusive NPC who is first mentioned in [[Phrolova]]'s [https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main/news/detail/2906 Resonator Introduction] and makes their first appearance during {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}}. They are the main antagonist of [[Wuthering Waves|''Wuthering Waves'']], finally confronting [[Rover]] and [[Galbrena]] in a central antagonistic role during {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}. They are the cunning, immortal leader of the [[Fractsidus]], who have worked for centuries to further their efforts, recruit new Overseers, and realize their grand design of putting fate into humanity's own hands through mass destruction, by facilitating a new evolution through the creation of a new Lament. Referenced by [[Galbrena]] as the "Thousand-Faced Survivor," this name is disturbingly literal, in reference to their ability to perfectly shapeshift into all manner of beings, both physical and conceptual entities alike, which they use to manipulate others for their designs. ==Physical Description== Schwarzloch's true form remains unknown. As Kharon, he appears as a towering, emaciated hooded figure, draped in layers of dark black robes that conceal all but his face, left half of his torso, and neck. Two thin black straps extend from his cloak's hip that end in golden buckles. He wears a metallic skull-like mask of silver with golden eyes. His mask is dented and cracked, with a vertical scar lining its left eye, and an oval gold plate layering its forehead. Two thin golden metal plates are aligned along the mask's jaw. He wears a shawl of gem-laced golden medallions over his shoulder and chest. His skin is grey with golden cracks, and the skin on his forearms and hands is black. He has a gold bangle on his left arm, and he wields a long, black staff that ends in golden vine-like barbs, with a golden, glowing lantern hanging down from the tip. Locks of lighter colored hair are visible beneath his hood around each side of his mask. ==Profile== Schwarzloch is the overarching leader of the [[Fractsidus]], with the title of the Grand Architect. Their true appearance is unknown due to their forte allowing them perfectly mimic the appearance and frequencies of other people. Whenever they appear in the story, they take on appearances that are not their own. Notable examples being Devoted Watcher, "[[Triss]]" and Kharon. Schwarzloch possesses a sly sense of quick-witted charisma and deft cunning, which play into the dynamics of every interaction they have shown thus far. When meeting Phrolova, Schwarzloch appeared in the form of a male audience member, using the form to embellish Phrolova's insecurities, encouraging her to pursue power and destruction as a way to bring back her hometown with the backing of their organization's resources. During [[Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens]], they took the form of Triss to hone Phrolova's focus back to the Fractsidus' goals rather than her immediate obsession with creating the [[Lost Beyond]], with Phrolova implying they frequently used this form in the past to psychologically manipulate her, which they claimed to do because she "liked" it. In the form of Kharon, they attempted to recruit Galbrena, something they once did when they met in the past at her refusal, attacking her for lacking humanity in comparison to the same humans she made an effort to save by hunting [[Tacet Discord]]s. They claimed that joining the Fractsidus would give her greater purpose. Their god complex fuels their belief that their vision for humanity is "beyond mortal comprehension," which they frustratedly belied once Galbrena again refused his offer. When met with defeat or setbacks, Schwarzloch remains calm and level-headed, and can even be honorable. After witnessing Leviathan's defeat, they merely spectated without intervening, remarking to Rover that theirs and the Fractsidus' paths were never truly opposed, before promising they would meet again, before departing alongside the other Overseers through a portal. Once Phrolova informed them she would be departing the Fractsidus after fulfilling her promises and duties to them, they responded calmly and pragmatically. They commanded Scar to back off from pursuing her, and allowed her to leave without conflict, as they affirmed their faith in their shared goals eventually reuniting. == Abilities == Schwarzloch is a [[Resonator]] of immense might with numerous abilities. According to [[Denia]], their Resonance ability is currently unknown with none of the abilities showcased being their true Forte, derivatives at best. Schwarzlock is also a very capable leader where [[Hiyuki]] can discover notes on the hidden machinations they have caused across [[Wishes in the Bell]]. Being well-prepared for different situations, Schwarzloch is also well-informed and acts accordingly to make the most of their plans. Through their long life they’ve gathered much knowledge across the world and are willing to manipulate and tempt others to work with the Fractsidus to achieve their goals. === Shapeshifting === One of Schwarzloch’s main abilities is shapeshifting and frequency mimicry, to such a powerful extent where [[Galbrena]] remarked that they are able to mimic the frequencies of concepts perfectly, which they demonstrated in mimicking the concept of death as Kharon. Galbrena even adds that they could forge an entirely new body with this power. This ability, combined with Schwarzloch’s acting and illusionary skills, means very few would realize they are the Grand Architect themself unless they break character. Even an observant character such as [[Luuk Herssen]] only had suspicions that their [[Nivora]] persona was actually them until he gained conclusive belief. They can alter their form in an instant if needed. According to Denia, however, their shapeshifting has a catch in that they need to observe and analyze their target in the long-term to pull it off. How this works with mythical figures is unknown, and it’s suggested that despite managing to shapeshift into Luuk’s father, couldn’t form the small scar the man had as Schwarzloch never noticed it properly. Those like [[Qiuyuan]] can also see through their shapeshifting by recognizing Schwarzloch’s frequency. === Illusions === In conjecture with their shapeshifting ability, while the extent of this power is unknown, Schwarzloch produced an entire group of life-like illusions of humans for Rover and Luuk to see at the SkyArk. For large scale illusions, ''Wishes in the Bell'' has Hiyuki venture through a realistic illusion of Honami that was peaceful while also seeing the backstage behind it. Schwarzloch can also communicate through these illusions if they please. === Frequency Manipulation === Though the extent of this power isn’t known, Schwarzloch is capable of interfering and manipulating with others’ frequencies. During their visit to [[Phrolova]], they could briefly grant the deceased [[Triss]] a temporary corporeal form to linger about outside Phrolova’s eye. To obstruct Qiuyuan, they awakened a sealed [[Fenrico]] from their stone prison to battle him. During their fight with Galbrena, they siphoned away all the Tacet Discords in her body to weaken her until Galbrena took them back in when she had the chance. === Teleportation === When meeting with Qiuyuan as Leon, Schwarzloch displayed short-ranged teleportation through black smoke. They can also open a gateway for long-range teleportation to travel vast distances. It’s these abilities, alongside the suggestion of their power to make clones, that allows them to be “everywhere” to gather intel. === Energy Manipulation === When fighting Galbrena in the Journeying Paradise, Schwarzloch can create red spheres of energy and energy beams to launch as attacks, and barriers for defense. === Clones === According to Galbrena, the Grand Architect met in the Journeying Paradise was a mere clone. While it’s unclear how powerful these clones are, they seemingly hold the same abilities as the original user and are formidable enough that while Galbrena suggested the clones are somewhat weaker, they injured her in battle. === Other abilities === Among the other abilities they wield, they include the ability to heal, as showcased when they recovered from Galbrena’s flames and when Luuk shot Schwarzloch in the head as Nivora, levitation, flight, producing near-invisible discs to walk on thin air, withstand the corrupting influence of [[Leviathan|Leviathan's]] Journeying Paradise, an immense longevity, and create additional limbs that can disconnect from their body that stretches, floats, and attack. ==Identities== The Grand Architect takes on multiple identities.
